name: Law Family Dependency Graph
purpose: Define the dependency relationships between law families to clarify the framework's logical hierarchy.

family_dependencies.role: Accessibility depends on valid selection and reach.
Basin persistence requires stable selection, transport, and projection.
Loss accounting requires active projection tracking.
Failures propagate from selection gaps and basin collapse.
Arbitration and grammar govern the composition of the entire stack.

governance_rules.rule: Every family must have at least one documented dependency or be marked as foundational (LF-001).
Dependency links must not imply global closure or physical causality.
